$description: BrandMark (platform/components/Brand, library wave 3): the tokens of the wordmark, the logo, the product marks, the tones and the sizes. The mark itself is generated by build-brand.js (brand.css).

brand-mark-color.$description: Brand: the brand blue of the mark (the kit’s primary color in light mode; the light blue in dark mode, as the kit’s mark on a dark background). There is no brand role in the theme yet: it reads the information blue, the same palette blue.

brand-name-color.$description: Brand: the wordmark’s and the application name’s color in the brand tone (the kit’s wordmark color, near black).

brand-tile-background.$description: Brand: the product mark’s tile in the brand tone: the brand blue.

brand-tile-icon.$description: Brand: the application icon on the brand tile.

brand-on-accent-color.$description: Brand: the mark, the wordmark and the application name on the accent (the white mark on the blue header).

brand-on-accent-tile-background.$description: Brand: the product mark’s tile on the accent: the accent content color.

brand-on-accent-tile-icon.$description: Brand: the application icon on the tile on the accent: the accent surface color, cut out of the tile.

brand-mono-tile-border-width.$description: Brand: the one-color product tile’s outline (one color: the tile is drawn as an outline in the current text color).

brand-name-font-family.$description: Brand: the wordmark’s face (the heading face).

brand-name-font-weight.$description: Brand: the wordmark’s weight (the kit’s wordmark is semibold).

brand-name-letter-spacing.$description: Brand: the wordmark’s letter spacing (the kit sets the wordmark tight).

brand-name-line-height.$description: Brand: the wordmark’s and the application name’s line height.

brand-app-font-family.$description: Brand: the application name’s face in a product mark.

brand-app-font-weight.$description: Brand: the application name’s weight in a product mark.

brand-sm-mark-size.$description: Brand: the mark’s square at SM (the minimum size).

brand-sm-font-size.$description: Brand: the wordmark and the application name at SM: a step of the type scale.

brand-sm-gap.$description: Brand: the space between the mark (or the tile) and the name at SM.

brand-sm-tile-size.$description: Brand: the product tile’s square at SM (as large as the mark).

brand-sm-icon-size.$description: Brand: the application icon in the product tile at SM.

brand-sm-tile-radius.$description: Brand: the product tile’s corners at SM.

brand-sm-clear-space.$description: Brand: the clear space around a lockup at SM (clearSpace): on the 4px grid, at least the kit’s 10% of the mark.

brand-md-mark-size.$description: Brand: the mark’s square at MD (the default lockup size).

brand-md-font-size.$description: Brand: the wordmark and the application name at MD: a step of the type scale.

brand-md-gap.$description: Brand: the space between the mark (or the tile) and the name at MD.

brand-md-tile-size.$description: Brand: the product tile’s square at MD (as large as the mark).

brand-md-icon-size.$description: Brand: the application icon in the product tile at MD.

brand-md-tile-radius.$description: Brand: the product tile’s corners at MD.

brand-md-clear-space.$description: Brand: the clear space around a lockup at MD (clearSpace): on the 4px grid, at least the kit’s 10% of the mark.

brand-lg-mark-size.$description: Brand: the mark’s square at LG (a sign-in page or a dialog).

brand-lg-font-size.$description: Brand: the wordmark and the application name at LG: a step of the type scale.

brand-lg-gap.$description: Brand: the space between the mark (or the tile) and the name at LG.

brand-lg-tile-size.$description: Brand: the product tile’s square at LG (as large as the mark).

brand-lg-icon-size.$description: Brand: the application icon in the product tile at LG.

brand-lg-tile-radius.$description: Brand: the product tile’s corners at LG.

brand-lg-clear-space.$description: Brand: the clear space around a lockup at LG (clearSpace): on the 4px grid, at least the kit’s 10% of the mark.

brand-xl-mark-size.$description: Brand: the mark’s square at XL (a welcome page or an about box).

brand-xl-font-size.$description: Brand: the wordmark and the application name at XL: a step of the type scale.

brand-xl-gap.$description: Brand: the space between the mark (or the tile) and the name at XL.

brand-xl-tile-size.$description: Brand: the product tile’s square at XL (as large as the mark).

brand-xl-icon-size.$description: Brand: the application icon in the product tile at XL.

brand-xl-tile-radius.$description: Brand: the product tile’s corners at XL.

brand-xl-clear-space.$description: Brand: the clear space around a lockup at XL (clearSpace): on the 4px grid, at least the kit’s 10% of the mark.
